member.name: M:PRN232.Lab1.API.Controllers.CoursesController.GetAll(System.String,System.String,System.String,System.Int32,System.Int32,System.Boolean,System.String)
member.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of courses.
member.param: Search keyword for CourseName (case-insensitive substring match).
The field to sort by. Supported: courseName. Default: courseId.
Sorting order: asc or desc. Default: asc.
Page number (starting from 1). Default: 1.
Number of elements per page. Default: 10.
If true, includes related data (Course -> Semester).

Comma-separated list of fields to return. Example: courseId,courseName,semesterId. Case-insensitive; invalid fields will be ignored. If left empty/null, all fields will be returned. Output keys are converted to camelCase.
